decisions.reason: As a multi-model desk system tightly aligned with the firm's office expertise and the shift toward flexible workplaces, it still offers strong strategic upside at relatively low option-holding cost.
A chair family is close to the core portfolio and complements the firm's interior solutions, so management would likely retain it unless results were clearly disappointing.

Floor cushions are a more peripheral niche and, after several years with many other product options available, the firm would likely redeploy resources if this concept has not clearly proven broader value.
The sofa fits the firm's lounge and residential positioning and designer-led premium offering, so the firm would usually continue it while its market potential remains credible.
A high standing table is close to the established workplace range and supports adaptable office and conference settings, giving it enough strategic relevance to keep the option open.

Although rugs are more distant from the historic core, this collection was framed as a flagship direction and therefore management is likely to preserve it longer to realize learning and positioning benefits.
